name: Friend of the Kirin Tor
summary: In Dalaran, Modera sends you to carry word that the city is calming and its wards may come down.

sections.title: The Good Word
sections.body: The Image of Archmage Modera says the council may dislike the subterfuge, but the results are plain. Dalaran is calming, and its wards may now be lowered. She sends you with this good word to Archmage Celindra in the Violet Citadel. For the journey, she gives you an arcane mote.

faq.q: Who sends you to Archmage Celindra?
aliases: who gives friend of the kirin tor
friend of the kirin tor quest giver
faq.answer: The Image of Archmage Modera sends you to deliver word that Dalaran is calming.

aliases: where to turn in friend of the kirin tor
faq.answer: Archmage Celindra is in the Violet Citadel, in the City of Dalaran.

faq.q: What item do you carry to the Violet Citadel?
aliases: friend of the kirin tor item
faq.answer: You carry an arcane mote Modera gives you for Archmage Celindra.
Dalaran is calming, and its wards may be lowered.
